capabilities.description: Handles the full reservation lifecycle including availability checks, real-time booking, modifications, cancellations, and stay records across all channels.
Manages rooms, rate plans, seasonal inventory, and property configuration for one or many hotel properties.
Calculates and adjusts room rates in real time based on demand, occupancy, seasonality, competitor signals, and configurable pricing rules.
Collects, moderates, and responds to guest reviews; analyzes sentiment and surfaces reputation trends for each property.
Provides operational dashboards and reports covering occupancy, revenue, booking pace, channel performance, and guest satisfaction.
Sends timely booking confirmations, reminders, pricing alerts, and internal staff notifications via email, SMS, and in-app channels.
Enables guests to search properties and rooms with filters, and recommends personalized stays, packages, and upsells based on preferences and history.

summary: StayFlow is an all-in-one hotel booking and property management platform for independent hotels, boutique inns, and small hotel groups. It unifies real-time reservation management, room inventory and rate control, dynamic pricing, guest reviews, and operational analytics, while keeping staff and guests informed with automated notifications and AI-assisted search and recommendations.
